data.prompt: Add three independent text helpers to this library, each in its own file with its own test file: slugify(text) turns a string into a lowercase url-safe slug; truncate(text, max) shortens a string to max characters and appends an ellipsis only when it had to cut; wordCount(text) returns the number of words. Keep each helper in its own file under src/ and its tests under test/. Also update README.md to document all three.
